title: lavandula burmanni
intro: Lavandula burmanni, commonly known as Burman's lavender, is a species of flowering plant in the lavender family Lamiaceae. This plant has been used for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce anxiety and stress levels, promote relaxation, and improve sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Lavandula burmanni include its sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic properties, which can help to soothe muscle tension and calm the mind. The bioactive constituents of this plant include linalool, linalyl acetate, and camphor, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
